<a id="acid_rain"></a>
## Acid House: `acid_rain.yml`

Acid house in A minor at 126 beats a minute, every part on the built-in
synths, written to show [Fishline](../synths/engines/FISHLINE.md). Two acid
lines carry it. The squelch is Fishline's saw through its Diode filter, deep
and resonant, its Acid gate set to Modded so that runs of accents climb higher
and higher. The answer is Fishline's square an octave up, Modded for a longer
slide and a little Filter FM. MechaDrum plays the synth kick, snare, hats and
cowbell.

The line hardly changes its notes: the home note on most steps, its octave,
the minor third, the fifth and the flat seventh. What moves is its marks. The
accents sit off the beat, a few slides a bar aim at an octave jump, and the
build adds accents into a run of three, so the filter climbs. The second drop
lifts the whole line a fourth.

<a id="duck_blur"></a>
## 8-Bit Game Theme: `duck_blur.yml`

A bright, fast 8-bit game theme in the manner of the DuckTales theme (Mark
Mueller), as a console of the eighties played it, every part on the built-in
synths: a square lead with a little vibrato, a two-oscillator chord stab, a
triangle bass bouncing octaves, and MechaDrum's kick, snare and hats. The
verse's busy patter of repeated notes is answered by short tags; the lift
climbs in two parallel lines while its snare rolls into the chorus; and the
chorus opens each half with two punchy notes and a high answer before a long
running line, over the borrowed chords bVI and bVII rising to I. A stuttering
bridge of calls and answers comes before the last two choruses. The chords of
every scene come from the [Chords](../generators/CHORDS.md) generator on the
chords and bass tracks.

<a id="cartridge_quest"></a>
## Chip Adventure Theme: `cartridge_quest.yml`

A home-computer adventure theme in D minor at 150 beats a minute, every sound
on the [SID](../synths/engines/SID.md) engine, as one sound chip of the 1980s
played it. The lead is a pulse wave whose width an LFO sweeps slowly through
the Mod Matrix, with a second LFO adding vibrato. The arpeggio plays each
chord as a single note, and the oscillator's Arpeggio steps it through root,
fifth and octave fifty times a second, the chip composer's way of sounding a
chord on one voice. A triangle plays the bass; the chip's noise wave plays the
snare and hats, and a triangle with a falling pitch plays the kick. In the
bridge a ring-modulated triangle rings like a bell under the lead.

<a id="side_pocket"></a>
## Chip Funk: `side_pocket.yml`

Chip funk in E dorian at 108 beats a minute with an eighth-note swing, every
sound on the [Pocket](../synths/engines/POCKET.md) engine, a handheld game
console's sound chip. It shows the Mod Matrix's MIDI CC sources: every pattern
carries CC rows that its track sends as CC 74, CC 71 and CC 1, and each Pocket
instrument routes CC 74 to its filter's cutoff, CC 71 to its resonance, and CC
1 through an LFO to its pitch, as a mod wheel adds vibrato. The notes repeat
while the CCs play the arrangement: the bass opens over the intro, pumps on
every beat, squelches against a rising resonance in the break and closes at
the end, and the lead is swept open, then wahs on every eighth, then sings
with vibrato growing on each held note.

<a id="machine_room"></a>
## Drum Machine Jam: `machine_room.yml`

A drum machine jam at 122 beats a minute on
[MechaDrum](../synths/engines/MECHADRUM.md), the built-in drum machine, each
of its ten machines heard in turn. The closed and open hats are one machine
with a short and a long Decay, in one choke group, so each closed hit cuts the
open one short. A Karplus Drum line in C minor pentatonic is tuned by its
notes, the Acoustic Tom plays a falling fill, and the drop swaps the kick for
the Hard Kick's broken electro pattern.
